name: rust-nested-fqn-clean
body: Nested projects must render clean, collision-free FQNs. Because a nested package's name differs from the root's (apg-rustfrontend vs apg), the ingestor's module-prefixed FQN rendering yields disjoint namespaces with no collision. AC: the nested crate's module FQN is apg-rustfrontend and its symbols are apg-rustfrontend.*; scanning the apg repo itself reports zero shadowed modules — no module is silently shadowed or merged away (src/ingest.rs:647-670) — and the nested module appears exactly once. (A module-level collision is silent shadowing, not an FQN-collision panic; only a genuine same-kind Struct/Function collision panics, in `claim`, src/ingest.rs:88-96.)
